stem:
Meera visits a science museum in Jaipur with her class. The guide shows the students four old devices used to measure time before clocks were common.
Which device measures time by the changing position of a shadow cast by the Sun?

options.text: A water clock, as water drips from one pot into another
A sundial, as the Sun moves across the sky
An hourglass, as sand falls from the upper bulb to the lower bulb
A candle clock, as the candle burns down past marked lines

teacher.key_rationale: A sundial indicates time through the changing position of a Sun-cast shadow; the other options correctly describe water flow, sand flow, and burning, but none of those uses a shadow. Therefore B is correct.
